description: Fetches an evidence receipt by its id (wem-evr- followed by 32 hex characters), as issued with a verify_offer result. Returns the receipt's fields: verdict, observed_at, source, amount, currency and amount_minor, identity_method, verifier, standardVersion and issuedAt, with `signed` true and an HMAC `signature` when WEM signed it. It holds the citation, not the product's offers. A receipt issued moments ago may not be fetchable yet.

id.description: Receipt id (wem-evr- followed by 32 hex characters), as returned in a verify_offer result's receipt.id.

name: get_evidence_receipt

outputSchema.description: A previously issued evidence receipt, looked up by id.

title: Look up a verification receipt by id
